q: In Nahum, against which city is the burden of the prophet?
why: Jonah had once preached there too.
quote: This is the burden against Nineveh

q: In Nahum, the LORD is good and a stronghold in the day of what?
why: He cares for those who trust Him.
quote: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress

q: In Nahum, the LORD is slow to anger and great in what?
quote: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power

q: In Nahum, what are the clouds beneath the LORD's feet?
why: His path is in the storm.
quote: and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.

q: In Nahum, for whom does the LORD care?
quote: He cares for those who trust in Him.

q: In Nahum, where was the prophet Nahum from?
quote: the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite

q: In Nahum, what does the prophet call Nineveh?
why: It was full of lies and plunder.
quote: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder
